title.zh: Community Alert: An EU entity is suspected of losing $106M+ from multiple centra
title.en: Community Alert: An EU entity is suspected of losing $106M+ from multiple centra

current_state.zh: A community alert reported that an EU entity is suspected of losing over $106 million from multiple centralized exchange accounts, with the stolen USDC and USDT being swapped into ETH, moved through instant exchanges, converted to XMR, and bridged across multiple chains.
